keyEvents.impact: Born as a close US ally with American bases and a US-modeled presidential system

keyEvents.event: Mutual Defense Treaty with the United States
keyEvents.impact: The oldest US treaty alliance in Asia; its applicability to the South China Sea is now the core question

keyEvents.event: People Power revolution ousts Ferdinand Marcos Sr.
keyEvents.impact: Restored democracy but left dynastic politics and military factionalism intact

keyEvents.event: US forces leave Subic Bay and Clark
keyEvents.impact: The vacuum let China occupy Mischief Reef in 1995 and later seize Scarborough Shoal in 2012

keyEvents.event: Arbitral tribunal rules against China's South China Sea claims; Duterte launches drug war and tilts to Beijing
keyEvents.impact: Won the legal case but shelved it for six years of accommodation with China

keyEvents.event: Marcos Jr. expands EDCA US access to nine bases and confronts China at Second Thomas Shoal
keyEvents.impact: Reversed Duterte's pivot and made the Philippines the frontline of US Indo-Pacific posture

keyEvents.event: Chinese coast guard axe-and-blade assault on a resupply mission at Second Thomas Shoal; Reciprocal Access Agreement with Japan
keyEvents.impact: Closest brush yet with triggering the US treaty; deepened Japan-Philippines defense ties

keyEvents.event: Ex-president Rodrigo Duterte arrested and flown to the ICC; flood-control corruption scandal sparks mass protests
keyEvents.impact: Turned the Marcos-Duterte feud into open political war and dented public trust in government

keyEvents.event: House impeaches Vice President Sara Duterte; repeated Chinese water-cannon attacks near Scarborough Shoal
keyEvents.impact: Domestic polarization peaks ahead of 2028 while Manila leans harder on Washington and Tokyo

history.narrative: A sprawling archipelago democracy of powerful political dynasties, sitting on the first island chain between Taiwan and the South China Sea. Militarily weak but strategically priceless, it relies on 'transparency' campaigns, the US alliance, and a growing web of Japanese and Australian partnerships to resist Chinese gray-zone pressure.

redLines.description: Chinese seizure of Second Thomas Shoal, Thitu (Pag-asa), or reclamation and militarization of Scarborough Shoal
Death of Filipino personnel in an armed attack on government vessels (would invoke the US Mutual Defense Treaty)
US failure to honor the Mutual Defense Treaty in the South China Sea

internalDivisions.name: Marcos-Duterte dynastic feud: VP impeachment, ICC case, and the 2028 succession
Muslim Bangsamoro autonomy in Mindanao and residual jihadist cells
Communist NPA insurgency remnants and anger over elite corruption

goals.description: Hold Philippine-occupied features and assert EEZ rights under the 2016 arbitral award
Keep the US alliance credible and deepen defense pacts with Japan and Australia
Sustain growth, attract manufacturing, and secure offshore gas as Malampaya runs dry
Contain the Marcos-Duterte feud and keep the military out of politics
